description: This file declares the BackportManager class responsible for managing backport functions for different versions of PyTorch's JIT bytecode. It provides methods to check for available backports, retrieve backport functions, and perform backporting from one version to another.

classes.name: BackportManager
classes.description: Manages backport functions for different bytecode versions and handles the backporting process.

methods.name: hasBytecodeBackportFunction
methods.description: Checks if a backport function exists for the specified version.

methods.name: bytecodeBackportFunctions
methods.description: Returns the registry of available backport functions.

methods.name: backport
methods.description: Performs backporting from one version to another, writing the result to the provided stream.

methods.name: BackportManager
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the BackportManager instance.

methods.name: registerBytecodeBackportFunction
methods.description: Registers a new backport function for a specific version.
